name: WOOVO Phuket Patong – by Swandor
detail: It was a trip abroad with friends after 7 years. The price was cheap, so I was skeptical, but the hotel condition was good. The staff were very friendly, and the breakfast was delicious. The pool was well maintained, and the water was clean. Above all, it was a very comfortable hotel. There are many massage shops in front of the hotel. The prices are also low, so I got a massage every day. There are also a few street food stalls in front of the 7-Eleven, and the som tam is incredibly delicious. It tastes just as good as any restaurant. I ate it every day. If I go to Phuket again, I plan to stay here again. You can take a taxi to Patong Beach; it costs 150 baht during the day and 200 baht at night. Make sure to negotiate this price. What they ask for can be unreasonable. It was a pleasant trip. Thank you to the staff at Ubo Hotel.

name: GP House Phuket
detail: The location is good, just right for both the beach and city walks. The hotel's facilities are a bit old, it's true, but the kindness of the staff exceeds that. They are very friendly and helpful; for instance, when I was swimming in the pool, they lent me goggles, which was very nice. They always greeted us with smiles and kindness, making my child very happy. The hotel pool is a well-maintained size for a hotel located in a busy area. Also, there is a small travel agency outside the hotel, and the women there are kind and offer reasonable prices. I booked an elephant ride and a ferry to Phi Phi Islands there, and although I checked elsewhere, this was the cheapest. It is very comforting to have a place that is kind to children when traveling with kids, so I feel glad to have stayed here.

name: Wyndham Grand Nai Harn Beach Phuket
detail: We had a great time staying here! The staff were super friendly and always had a smile, especially the restaurant team. We were traveling with a young child, and the staff at the Kids' Club were really helpful and took great care of our little one. Also, huge thanks to the housekeeping team. At first, we told them not to clean because we felt bad about how messy our room was with all our kid's stuff. But when we came back in the evening, they had made everything completely clean and organized. If you're looking for a quiet, relaxing family trip near Nai Harn Beach, definitely stay here.
area: Nai Harn Beach,Phuket - View on map

name: Lub d Phuket Patong
detail: It is a small, minimalist hotel with convenient travel options, allowing you to walk to the beach and various places. All the staff are lovely and provide great recommendations. Most of the guests are foreigners, about 99%. The hotel offers car rental services, making it convenient. The chosen room may be a bit small, but it has a view overlooking the pool. It is fully equipped with amenities, although there is no refrigerator. The bed is soft and very comfortable to sleep in. The hotel has a good vibe and many activities to do. I recommend staying here; it’s great!

name: Saba Suites Hotel Patong Phuket
detail: It's nice that the central shopping area and Patong Beach are close. If you come considering that it gets noisy outside until dawn and the windows are thin, it will be a reasonable choice. The staff at Maple were kind and helpful. Thank you.

name: The Blue Mavi Hotel
detail: A new hotel in the heart of Phuket city, with a beautiful and spacious lobby and guest rooms. It has complete amenities, suitable for family vacations, couples, or those with small children. It is popular among foreign tourists who come to learn Muay Thai and exercise because it offers a sauna and a free cold water pool for guests, as well as a panoramic swimming pool with a 180-degree view on the rooftop. The security is excellent, and the reception staff and owner are very friendly, making you feel warm during your stay here. There is a ground-level parking area that can accommodate several cars. If you have the opportunity to travel for business or visit Phuket, consider staying here, and you will feel equally impressed. ❤️

name: The Sixteenth Naiyang Beach Hotel - Free Schedule Airport Shuttle
detail: If you call from the airport, they will provide a free pick-up. They also offer pick-up when going to the airport. The atmosphere in the neighborhood was very nice. It was quiet, people were friendly, and there were many Westerners. Next time, I think it would be nice to stay in this area for about three days. The cost of living is cheaper than in town~~ There are many good restaurants, and a huge number of convenience stores. Breakfast is served on the 3rd floor; there aren't many options, but everything is neat and very delicious. It's in the style of Thai food. The chicken curry was impressive. The lady would immediately wipe up any drop of sauce that fell. It was clean and nice to eat breakfast quietly. Additionally, on the staff's recommendation, I went to a massage shop. It offered the best value for money. It's right next to the accommodation, named Win Massage Shop, and they were friendly and very enthusiastic. The one-hour Thai massage was 300 baht. It may not be perfect, but one downside would be that there should have been a bathroom exhaust fan. Oh, and Phuket has many places with damp beds, but the bed here was dry and comfortable.

name: Ibis Styles Phuket City
detail: There are many good restaurants nearby, and it was nice because it was quieter than the busy area. You can easily get to the city center by taking a free bus from near the hotel. I stayed for two days, and the shower filter was also good. The cost performance is great, so I would like to visit again.

name: Zostel Phuket, Patong Beach
detail: Rien à dire l’endroit est juste magnifique et propre, le staff est très sympathique et les activités sont bien au rendez-vous, je recommande fortement

name: Patong Terrace Boutique Hotel
detail: Clean, convenient, close to the sea, below the shop there are services like massage, restaurants, 7-Eleven, entertainment venues.
